heroSubtitle: Total control over stock levels, batch tracking, warehouse transfers, and real-time inventory valuations without human error.
visionTitle: Protect and Optimize Your Working Capital
visionDesc: Inventory is frozen cash. USoft helps you identify slow-moving stock, prevent stock-outs, and accelerate inventory turnover.

features.title: Multi-Warehouse & Stock Transfers
features.desc: Manage unlimited warehouses, branch hubs, transit vans, and consignment inventory with automated inter-branch transfer workflows.

features.title: Barcode, Batch & Serial Tracking
features.desc: Print custom barcode & QR labels, track batch/lot numbers, expiration dates, and unique serial numbers with First-Expired, First-Out logic.

features.title: Automated Reorder Level & Safety Stock Triggers
features.desc: Set custom safety buffers and reorder thresholds per SKU per location. System triggers purchase suggestions automatically.

features.title: Weighted Average Inventory Valuation
features.desc: Real-time financial valuation using moving weighted average cost with automatic Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) general ledger posting.

features.title: Continuous Cycle Counting & Reconciliation
features.desc: Conduct cycle counts without shutting down warehouse operations using mobile handhelds with automated variance reconciliations.

features.title: Bin Locations & Movement Authorization
features.desc: Assign precise warehouse bin locations and mandate authorized dispatch vouchers linked directly to sales or production orders.

steps.title: Receiving & Barcoding
steps.desc: Scan incoming goods, generate barcodes, and post stock-in.

steps.title: Bin Allocation
steps.desc: Assign goods to designated bins for fast picking.

steps.title: Picking & Dispatch
steps.desc: Pick items and decrement on-hand inventory instantly upon sale.

steps.title: Valuation & Audits
steps.desc: Recalculate weighted cost and reconcile financial ledgers.
